title: A reorder you can trust · a sketch for Finale Inventory by Juan Pablo García
desc: A reorder assistant that keeps the math in tested code and uses a model only to explain it and draft the PO.
h1: A reorder suggestion a buyer can trust in ten seconds
lede: Your site puts it plainly. Without sales velocity, lead time and margin data, buying is guesswork. Finale already has those inputs across every channel, warehouse and FBA. What is hard for a seller is trusting a suggested number. This sketch keeps the math in tested code and uses a model only to explain it and draft the PO.
stage: From channel sales to an approved purchase order

flow.label: Diagram of a reorder pipeline where code computes the quantity and a model only writes the explanation

steps.d: Orders per channel, stock in every location including FBA, open purchase orders and lead time per supplier.
A promo week on Amazon or ten days out of stock both distort the average. Those days get flagged and handled before any math runs.
The reorder point is daily velocity times lead time plus safety days. The quantity covers the target days after arrival, minus stock on hand and inbound. No model touches this.

steps.t: The model writes, it does not calculate
steps.d: It gets the finished numbers and writes two things, a short reason for the buyer and the note to the supplier.

steps.t: Nothing ships with a wrong number
steps.d: Every figure in the text is compared with what the engine produced. One mismatch and the draft is regenerated or replaced with a plain template.
The buyer sees the quantity, the reason and the draft. They approve, edit or skip.
When a buyer changes a suggestion, the change is logged. It shows where safety days or spike rules are wrong for that seller.
